mainEntity.name: Do I need permits for a full kitchen renovation in Berkeley?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, most full kitchen renovations in Berkeley and surrounding East Bay cities require permits. This is especially true if the project involves altering the layout, moving plumbing or electrical lines, or making structural changes. Obtaining the correct permits ensures your renovation complies with local building codes and safety regulations. We can assist you with the permit application process.
